Let R0 be the normalized data-level rank/affine-quadratic-fiber reference of the accepted A068 base theorem, extended by zero on padding frequencies, delta=2^-N, and R_delta=(1-delta)R0+delta U_N. Then R_delta is normalized with full support, H(G)<=Gamma_delta(G)<=C_reg I_x(G)+2I_z(G)-(287/1920)I_x(F_q), where C_reg=log2(4+e)+2log2(e*pi), I_x(F_q)=q binom(q-1,(q-1)/2)/2^(q-1), and I_z includes padding. For fixed q under padding and a one-point edit, Gamma_delta(G) tends to Gamma0(F_q).
